in_hebrew.name: Maiga
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mother of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Maiga הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Maiga means 'Mother of God'. This name is derived from the Aramaic term 'Mariam', which is the biblical name for Mary, the mother of Jesus. In Christian tradition, Mary is revered as the Mother of God, and Maiga is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl born into this faith.
